'''Deepfin Mine''' is a [[List of dungeons|dungeon]] containing several mineable rocks including [[lead rocks]] and [[nickel rocks]]. It is accessible by entering the cave on [[Deepfin Point]], which requires level 67 [[Sailing]] to dock at (unboostable).

The dungeon contains two unbuilt [[bank chest space]]s as well as [[Durrik's Goods]], a [[general store]] with a unique stock of items for sale. Each bank chest requires 1 [[magic stone]], 2 [[cupronickel bar]]s, 2 [[adamantite bar]]s, and 4 [[ironwood plank]]s to build. The two eastern parts of the mine are linked with an agility shortcut, requiring 84 Agility to use.

There are also attackable [[aberrant spectre]]s, [[Ankou#Level 95|ankou]], and [[giant ant]]s to the east. A [[dwarf multicannon]] can be used in this dungeon, but the areas are [[single-way combat]].

==Trivia==
* [[Durrik]] implies there is a specific reason beyond ore that the dwarves are mining here for, but does not clarify what that reason is. The dwarves are mining to the east; directly to the east of Deepfin Point lies the [[Isle of Souls]]. This may be related to their true reason for mining here.
